paragraphs: The GLK220 CDI/d is the diesel mainstay of the GLK-Class range, produced from 2008 to 2015 across the single-generation X204 chassis. It uses the OM651 2.1-litre inline-four diesel — an engine shared widely across Mercedes models of that era, including the C-Class and E-Class families. The GLK-Class was discontinued in 2015 and succeeded by the GLC, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLK220 CDI D on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLK220 CDI D from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
